note: Submodule of form_mode_manager. Auto-assigns user roles when someone registers/is created through a Form Mode Manager user form mode. FormAlter reads form_mode_user_roles_assign.settings -> form_modes.user_<form_mode>.assign_roles and sets those roles as the default value of the register form's roles element (only on user FMM routes matching /user/register/.. or /admin/people/create/..). Configure route form_mode_manager.admin_settings_roles_assign (/admin/config/content/form_mode_manager/role-assign). Config key prefix is 'user_' + the form-mode machine name. Cases are grounded on this config; role ids used in fixtures are namespaced (fmra_*) and only need to exist as config strings. Baseline is empty form_modes; reset/cleanup clear it.

evals.prompt: What does the form_mode_user_roles_assign submodule do, and where is it configured?
evals.expected_output: It automatically assigns user roles when a user registers/is created through a Form Mode Manager user form mode. Configure it at /admin/config/content/form_mode_manager/role-assign.

evals.prompt: Which config object and key path does form_mode_user_roles_assign use to store which roles get assigned for a given user form mode?
evals.expected_output: Config object form_mode_user_roles_assign.settings, key form_modes.user_<form_mode>.assign_roles (a list of role ids). The key uses the 'user_' prefix plus the form-mode machine name.

evals.prompt: On which forms/routes does form_mode_user_roles_assign actually apply the configured roles, and how does it apply them?
evals.expected_output: Only on Form Mode Manager 'user' routes matching the register/create path pattern (/user/register/.. or /admin/people/create/..). It sets the configured roles as the default (pre-checked) value of the register form's roles element.

evals.prompt: On this site, form_mode_user_roles_assign is configured so that the 'partner' user form mode auto-assigns a role. Inspect the live configuration and name the role it assigns.
The 'vip' user form mode on this site is configured with form_mode_user_roles_assign to grant multiple roles. Inspect the live configuration and list the roles it assigns.
Using form_mode_user_roles_assign, configure the 'task' user form mode so that users registering through it are automatically assigned the role 'fmra_task'. Apply the change to the live site.

The 'team' user form mode is already configured with form_mode_user_roles_assign to assign the role fmra_team_a. Add a second automatically-assigned role fmra_team_b to that same form mode, keeping the existing one. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: form_mode_user_roles_assign.settings form_modes.user_team.assign_roles contains BOTH fmra_team_a and fmra_team_b.
